principle: 10/10 is a release gate, not a decorative label.

operational_quality.scope: all current TRA production surfaces represented by TRA_VERSION.json
operational_quality.meaning: engineering release quality backed by automated repository checks, runtime telemetry hooks, offline behavior and live HTTP verification
operational_quality.does_not_claim: absolute perfection, permanent third-party uptime, or replacement for future human usability testing

perfect_scale.rule: The perfect score may be claimed only when every dimension and every hard guardrail has current evidence.

dimensions.gate: zero known false claims or wrong content
keyboard, focus, reduced motion, forced-colors support, touch targets and readable mobile experience
critical paths remain useful without connectivity and unknown offline routes never masquerade as another product
all automated functional, route, smoke and live HTTP checks pass
no permission bypass, secret exposure, unsafe external action or opener leak from new-tab links
responsive interaction, fresh network-first assets, bounded media behavior and Web Vitals evidence hooks
clear flows for technical and non-technical users, skip navigation and neutral recovery states
content supports TRA mission and audience
history preserved and human approval enforced

hard_guardrails: No known false or invented information
No critical security or privacy issue
No empty exposed game or category
All CI gates pass on the exact candidate commit
Live HTTP verification passes after publication
Human approval exists before merge and publication
